comments.author: aleves
comments.body_html:
Hi!

I would be lying if I said that this project is in active development, but I haven’t killed it either. All I’m doing now is to keep it up to date with new releases of SPT-AKI and perhaps try to implement some small changes/fixes. Here’s a sneak peek of my changelog made for my next release when SPT-AKI 2.2.0 is live,

  • [Change] Updated for SPT-AKI 2.2.0 + EFT 12.12.TBA.TBA
  • [Fix] The VSS/VAL rear-sight was goofed by me since v1.0.3, now ungoofed
  • [New] HK USP rail adapter and HK USP .45 ACP Match compensator now compatible with picatinny grips
  • [New] HK USP rail adapter and HK USP .45 ACP Match compensator now compatible with UM3 Sight Mount
  • [New] UM3 Sight Mount and Glock TS Sight Mount now have more scopes/sights*
  • [New] The UM3 Sight Mount is now mountable on M45A1*
  • [New] T12W added to Recknagel scope mounts top rails
  • [New] MTs-255 755mm rib now compatible with more 12ga muzzle attachments
  • [New] ETMI-019 shotgun rail mount now have more scopes/sights

* Thanks Demon_Hawk!

  1. Sounds like a mod conflict, but I can’t say for sure until you give me a full list of your mods.
  2. Fixed and will be available in the next release! The UM3 will be a thing at the very least.
  3. Do you mean my readme’s or something else? I think my only mention of FN 5-7 is the full-auto thingy in readme-[adamCAW] (which I’ve never made in the first place as I only ported their mod essentially). Regardless, I don’t think I’m going to investigate this suggestion for the time being as I find the bridge mounts to be good enough, which covers almost all the pistols (beside a few Russian guns that don’t really have any good mounts for bridges/rails).
  4. The UM3 Sight Mount and the Glock TS Sight Mount will have more stuff compatible in the next release!
  5. I made a quick attempt at this and I couldn’t figure out why the stock is invisible when attached. So this suggestion is going in the low-priority* pile for now. Sorry!
  6. I actually made some attempts at this as well, but I never managed to make anything useful. I even began making a new stock for the M9 in Blender, but I don’t know anything about 3D modeling (and I’m lazy/stupid), so that little adventure died real fast. The other stocks that already exists clips right through the pistols, so I would’ve to clone their bundles, adjust the positions to make them fit (lots of trial and error) and then make new entries as this new bundle will become its own item. So maybe it’s not impossible, but this is also in the low-priority* pile since it needs more research.

* Stuff that I might try to fix, but indefinitely or when I happen to feel like it.

Thank you for showing interest in my project and thank you for your suggestions! Don’t worry about it though, any feedback is better than no feedback. I’m just sorry that I might not be able to provide all the suggestions that you’ve made beside those already mentioned in my changelogs.

As for assisting me, an offer which I’m very grateful for, might not be in the plans for me in the time being. I would’ve have to get you up to speed with all my stuff as nothing in it really is user-friendly beside my half-assed comments in the code where I try to describe everything. My knowledge with JS/JSON is extremely limited as well, so I wouldn’t be able to teach anything as I’m barely grasping on my own. But with that said, you’re absolutely free to experiment with alevesThings on your own as much you’d like, as long you do so in good faith and try to keep any questions regarding the code to a minimum as I’m not actively working on this project. If you happen to get any new suggestions that you’d like to share with me then I’m all open ears!

Thanks again!

    Enabled by default, but the addon can be disabled through AllStuff-config.json if needed.

You should find the config inside “..\user\mods\alevesThings\config“. Open the config in a text editor, find “Load: FreakLimiter”: true,, replace true with false and save the file. If you just want to enable 9mm barrels and leave the rest alone, find “MPXplague”: true, and do the same as mentioned above.

Cheers
